items.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
items.summary: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

items.title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
items.summary: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

items.title: U.S. Fed Governor Waller pitches keeping central bank at the center of tokenization
items.summary: Waller suggested the Federal Reserve could provide trusted rails for emerging innovation tied to tokenized assets and agentic AI.

items.title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says
items.summary: Luxor said hackers redirected hashrate from just over a dozen client accounts through its Commander tool, and its CEO blamed a “sophisticated AI-enabled vector.”

items.title: World Bank Group taps Circle and Citi to test stablecoin-based fund disbursements
items.summary: The initiative plans to initially focus on an intermediated and interoperable stablecoin-based payment model.
